note: Sun 15 Nov 2026 SGT run: weekend check against Fri 13 Nov US close (no new trading session since). CNN Fear & Greed held flat at 39/Fear (markets closed, unchanged from Friday), but crypto Fear & Greed deepened sharply to 13/Extreme Fear (from Fri's 20) per a direct alternative.me read as the weekend Bitcoin selloff intensified -- BTC fell from Friday's $68,249 close toward roughly $63,400 by Sunday morning SGT on $1.6B+ in liquidations, confirming this is a genuine deleveraging event rather than noise.
